candidate_relations.reason: Atypical mitotically active infiltrative spindle-cell tumor associated with peripheral nerves in an NF1 patient supports malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Exact diagnostic equivalent of the benchmark.

candidate_relations.reason: Leiomyosarcoma is not the benchmark diagnosis, and the tumor is negative for desmin and smooth muscle actin.
The superficial bland spindle-cell proliferation resembles neurofibroma, but the deep atypical, mitotically active infiltrative component establishes malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Benign peripheral nerve sheath component or possible precursor, lacking malignant transformation.

candidate_relations.reason: Malignant triton tumor is an MPNST with rhabdomyoblastic differentiation, which is not described and is unsupported by negative myogenin and desmin staining.
The record supports MPNST but does not demonstrate divergent differentiation; muscle-lineage markers are negative and no other divergent component is identified.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: MPNST with an additional divergent differentiation component not established in the record.

candidate_relations.reason: Fibromatosis does not account for the nerve association, S100 positivity, marked atypia, and frequent mitoses characteristic of the malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.
